source.note: Kenney Furniture Kit 2.0 `tableCoffee` (GLB), not the plan's Quaternius table (poly.pizza only, blocked by a Cloudflare challenge). Rendered against the kit's other tables: `table` (dining, same frame; at 0.75 m its top would be 1.93 x 1.03 m, and at the kit's own scale it is only 0.63 m tall), `tableCloth` (same with a runner), `tableGlass` (white frame, glass top: reads as a white box in cel), `tableCross` (trestle legs, rustic), `tableRound` (actually a hexagonal pedestal top, 1.5 m across at kit scale), the coffee squares and glass versions. `tableCoffee` reads best: a solid wood top over four square legs and low stretchers, clear two-tone (pale top, dark sides), and as a low table it fits apartment scenes (Japanese chabudai/kotatsu use, floor seating). At 0.38 m (kotatsu height) the top is 1.09 x 0.66 m; the kit's scale (desk-teacher 0.74 m) would make it 0.44 m, a western coffee table, so this is 14 % under kit scale. Same wood roles and hexes as desk-teacher. Long side along X, symmetric. Static, no clips.
